Name: Wildflour's Atelier Goods - An Artisan Goods Expansion
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][img]https://i.imgur.com/buIbPlm.png[/img]﻿
[i]
[/i][size=3][i]An all in one artisan good expansion mod. Add as many or as few categories as you like to run the atelier of your dreams. Adds items such as edible forage, baked goods, specialty ales and meads, floral artisan goods, frozen treats, candy and more! [/i]

[/size][size=5][/size][quote][size=5]CHECK OUT OUR WIKI HERE -> [url=https://wildfloursateliergoods.wiki.gg/wiki/Wildflour%27s_Atelier_Goods_Wiki]WAG WIKI[/url]﻿ [/size][/quote][size=3]
Highly configurable to all play styles, it also includes toggles for difficulty, perfection requirements and crops and forage. This mod also includes new mail and tips from villagers and unlockable shopkeepers via bundles and a new location.[/size][size=4]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[i]The mod currently includes these artisan goods:[/i][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3]
[font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][b] ﻿Baker[/b][/color]: breads, cakes, cupcakes, doughnuts, muffins, cookies, puddings and pies
[color=#b6d7a8][b] ﻿Barista[/b][/color][b]:[/b] coffee, tea, boba, kombucha, iced lattes, lemonade and smoothies
[color=#b6d7a8][b] ﻿Boutique:[/b][/color] dried flowers, perfume, incense, candles, soap, bouquets and makeup
[color=#b6d7a8][b] ﻿Brewer[/b][/color][/font]:[font=Georgia] ales and meads
[color=#b6d7a8][b] ﻿Candy:[/b][/color] chocolates, fairy floss, gumballs, hard candies, jelly beans, lollipops, marshmallows
[font=Georgia][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][b] ﻿Frozen:[/b][/color] ice cream, ice cream sandwiches, milkshakes and popsicles[/font][/font]
[color=#b6d7a8][b] ﻿Gourmand Items[/b][/color]: jams, pickles, cooking ingredients and packaged goods[/font]
[/size][center][size=3]
The mod also includes forage for each season, focused on edible herbs, flowers and nuts. These can be turned off via config but are required for certain categories of artisan goods.
[color=#b6d7a8]
[b]Note: if you played with previous versions of WAG you [u]must[/u] remove the following as they are now in this one mod: [/b][/color]Forager, Barista Hot/Cold, Brewer, Canner, Confectioner Frozen/Sweet, Cosmetologist, Florist, Forager, Garden Variety Seeds, Gourmand, Pickler, HxW Freshly Baked. You must also remove Bee's Knees, Witch's Familiars and Special Orders (see FAQ).[/size]

[font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]Difficulty Toggles[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Simple:[/color][/b] This follows vanilla structure for jelly/wine etc, in that you can make flavored items like flavored ale or flavored mead, but you will only be required to ship 1 of each for your collection. The items will inherit the input item's name and color and it still uses honey or hops as fuel, but this is the more vanilla-focused option for those who don't want extra crops.

[b][color=#b6d7a8]Advanced:[/color][/b] Requires Wild Food enabled in Cauldron for added crops.  These items are more valuable but are more difficult to make. They often require more than 1 input per item. For example,  Gentle Breeze Mead requires Chamomile and Dandelion in addition to the  normal honey fuel.

[b][color=#b6d7a8]Shipping Collection[/color][/b] and [color=#b6d7a8][b]Easy Recipe Toggles[/b][/color] are still available in Cauldron but they now apply to the entire mod, not per category.
[/size][/font][center][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#a2c4c9]
[/color][/size][/font][color=#b6d7a8][font=Georgia][size=5][b]Junimo Coin Custom Currency[/b][/size][/font][/color][/center][font=Georgia][size=3]
This is a new by-product! Get a junimo gem for every WAG item crafted  in machines and spend them with new shopkeepers for more machines, ingredients, recipes, seeds etc.

[/size][/font][center][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b][font=Georgia]Shopkeepers[/font][/b][font=Georgia][b] and Bundles[/b][/font][/size][/color][font=Georgia][size=3]

Unlock a whole host of adorable new shopkeepers with magical bundles. Check by the hat mouse to get started.[/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3]
   [b] [color=#b6d7a8]Rose Mouse[/color][/b]: ingredients & baking items
  [b] [color=#b6d7a8] Wisteria Mouse[/color]:[/b] H&W Furniture; cosmetic items
    [b][color=#b6d7a8]Alchemist[/color]:[/b] forage and seeds
   [b] [color=#b6d7a8]Florian Hare[/color]:[/b] floral items
    [b][color=#b6d7a8]Toffee Hedgehog[/color]:[/b] candy and frozen items
   [b] [color=#b6d7a8]Stout Badger[/color]:[/b] brewing and beverage items
 [color=#b6d7a8]   [/color][b][color=#b6d7a8]Mason Mouse[/color]:[/b] pickling and canning items
[/size][/font][size=2]
[/size][center][b][size=4]Don't forget to install Cauldron and check out the various configuration settings![/size][/b][/center][font=Georgia]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/y8dJ6qH.png[/img]﻿﻿
[b]

[font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=3][quote][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Is this going to cause lag because it's one big mod?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/quote]
Nope! The mod is highly configurable and if a given category isn't enabled, it isn't loaded into the game. It's also been tested with all categories turned on and it does not cause lag; however, all PC setups are different and how many mods you use can affect this as well.

[/size][/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]How do I make this item? How do I unlock this machine?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
You can download and use the mod Lookup Anything to use on machine recipes. There are also machine descriptions that often explain how to make an item. If you are very curious, you can always go look in the code files to figure this out as well.

There is also a WIKI - [url=https://wildfloursateliergoods.wiki.gg/wiki/Wildflour%27s_Atelier_Goods_Wiki]https://wildfloursateliergoods.wiki.gg/wiki/Wildflour%27s_Atelier_Goods_Wiki[/url]﻿[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Can I use another mod’s crops in these machines?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
Probably! Machine rules are typically written in this mod using context tags, which allows for great compatibility. If you find issues using a certain crop mod, you can reach out to that mod author about adding context tags to their items. 

[/size][/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]What if I only want to use the base game crops?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
The “simple” mode was created explicitly for this purpose and mimics the base game method of artisan crafting. Simply uncheck the “Wild Food” tab in Cauldron and set your difficulty to simple. Note that some item categories that require special crops, like chocolate or marshmallows, cannot be used without the Wild Food crops.

[/size][/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Why are you making all of the IDs change AGAIN? You are messing up my save!
It takes so much time for me to update! This is so annoying![/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
I’d like to remind anyone who would like to complain to me about this that I am not paid to create this content, and you are not owed this content.  These are, at the end of the day, my mods, and I can do with them what I like. I made the decision to combine them all into one extremely  customizable mod with new content and I am proud of my work. Do not come into my space to complain to me about how the months of work I spent on my mod annoys you. You do not have to update; you do not have to use my mod. Opinions like this are rude, entitled, and will be removed from  the mod page. 

[/size][/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]There aren’t unique gift tastes or food buffs! This ruins my immersion. Will you fix it?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
No - this is not a bug or a forgotten misstep. This mod has almost 1K items and it's incredibly tedious to add that kind of information to  each item. Feel free to make a personal edit if you feel it is game-breaking for your immersion. Or, feel free to use another artisan mod other than this one.

[/size][/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]The forage spawns too much/not enough! Will you fix this?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
There is nothing to fix as the forage spawns the way I intended it to. If you would like it to change, feel free to make a personal edit of your FTM file. 

[font=Georgia][quote][b][i][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Where did Garden Variety Seeds go?[/size][/color][/font][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]
What about HxW Farmer's Market Crafting and HxW Freshly Baked?[/size][/color][/font][/i][/b][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
They have been added to this mod! Freshly Baked is now the Baker modules. Farmer's Market crafting is listed as "Packaged Goods" on the Gourmand page in Cauldron, and you can enable Garden Variety Seeds under the  Global Options in Cauldron as well. [/size][/font][/font]

[/size][/font][quote][b][i][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Where did all the magical items from Faerie Garden go?[/size][/color][/font][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]
What about Bee's Knee's or Witch's Familiars?[/size][/color][/font][/i][/b][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
They have all been moved to my Sunberry Add on NPC Mod - Rose and The Alchemist !

[/size][quote][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Will you bring back Community Center Bundle mods? [/i][/b][/size][/color][/quote][size=3]
 No - unfortunately they are just too time consuming and I have fallen in love with Unlockable Bundles so any bundles I do will be with this framework.
[/size]
[/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Why do these items say they are all worth 100G ?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
These are placeholders that you can see when you look items up in Lookup Anything or CJB Item Spawner. The machines handle the pricing dynamically based on the inputs used in crafting.
[/size][/font][size=3]
[/size][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Can I translate your mod?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
Please reach out to me to obtain permission to translate my mod before  uploading it to Nexus. If someone is already in process of translating, then I will ask you not to upload it as it is already in process. I reserve the right to report your translation if it was posted without my permission or to revoke permission should I find it is poorly translated or changes things with malicious intent.

NO AI MAY BE USED IN ANY WAY IN RELATION TO MY MODS.[/size][/font][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/l37mCaT.png[/img][/size][/font]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b][quote][i][color=#b6d7a8]Can I use this in older versions of the game?[/color][/i][/quote] [/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
This mod is for SDV 1.6 - it is not compatible with older versions of the game. 

I will not maintain older versions on Nexus; people often download the wrong file and then complain it does not work.

[/size][/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Does this mod support multiplayer or mobile?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
It is untested for mobile and as mobile modding is unavailable for the foreseeable future, I will not be providing mobile support for my mods. For multiplayer. if all the same mods are installed, multiplayer should be fine. I cannot troubleshoot multiplayer. Your best bet is to try the SDV modded game support discord channel as it is often too hard for me to diagnose the issue across multiplayer saves.

[quote][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][i][b]Can I use this with older versions of your mods? [/b][/i][/size][/color][/quote]
No - this is a new all in one experience and as such should be considered separate from the older versions of the mods. If you want to keep playing with your existing save and the older versions, [i]do not update Cauldron or add this to your save.

[/i][/size][size=4][i][b][quote][color=#b6d7a8]Can this be used on an existing save?[/color][/quote][/b][/i][/size][size=3]
This mod is safe to use in existing saves of modded Stardew Valley if you didn't have my older mods installed. If you did, error items [u]will[/u] show up. [u]They are absolutely harmless[/u] and you just trash them. That's the point of error items. But again, as the question above says, this is basically a new mod. Fresh installs and fresh saves are what I can provide support for.

There is a [b]lot of new content in this mod though and it is highly recommended to start a new save[/b] so that the new content isn't all just dumped on you mid game but you absolutely can if you wish to.

[font=Georgia][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]Is this compatible with “SVE”, “RSV”, "Cornucopia", “insert other mod name” here?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][font=Georgia][size=3]
Yes. My items have unique internal IDs and thus do not conflict with others. You may have more than one of a similar item if you use other crop mods, but they do not cause issues.
[/size][/font][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/rSzqpms.png[/img][/size][/font]
[/size][/font][quote][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]HELP! The mod isn’t working! What do I do?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/quote][/center][list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Ensure your mods are up to date. Not just my mods - all of your mods. If I get a log with out of date mods I will not help you.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Delete the old version of the mod and go download a fresh version and install. Do NOT overwrite. [/size][/font]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Still not working? Go to [b]log.smapi.io[/b] and follow the instructions there to get your game log.[/font][/size]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Please look at your log first before submitting a bug report, as it can often tell you how to solve the problem.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Submit log via the [b]bug reports tab[/b] with a detailed description of your issue and a copy of your cauldron config.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3]
Do [b]NOT[/b] copy and paste the raw data text. Do [b]NOT[/b] submit a bug report without a SMAPI log. If a bug report is already present for your bug, do [b]NOT[/b] duplicate it with another report. Doing so will result in the removal of said bug report. Continued ignoring of these guidelines will result in me blocking you from commenting on my mods.

[center][quote][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]The shopkeeper warp disappeared! HELP?![/i][/b][/size][/color][/quote][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i][/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/font]
If you have recently installed Sunberry, the warp will have moved to Sunberry Road. For new saves you get a letter about this, but for existing saves it could be a little scary so I appreciate your understanding![/center][/size][/font][/font]
